abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a spinning crystal spear, dealing DMG to opponents ahead.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Havoc: Sunder (Seven-Phase Flash)
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: after the in-stance burst, normal hits deal bonus DMG on a repeating 0.1s trigger (up to 10 times), raised further by Void Rifts absorbed during that burst.
_curatorNotes: In-stance normals: separate 5-hit Cryo chain with different frames + scaling. attackSkillHitmarks=[[12],[11],[11,23],[11,27],[25]]; attackSkillFrames built via InitNormalCancelSlice with skillAttack[N] multipliers.
Authored as a normal-typed dual variant with state:inStance condition (varesa/cyno-shape). IgnoreInfusion:true blocks Pyro/Hydro/Electro infusion override.

Charge in stance: chargeSkillFrames=InitAbilSlice(54), ActionCharge=53 ActionBurst=43 ActionDash=27 ActionJump=28 ActionWalk=52 ActionSwap=42. ActionSkill not overridden (Skirk can't recast E in-stance per NextQueueItemIsValid). E key omitted from chargeFrames. CA in stance is a 3-hit sequence (chargeSkillHitmarks=[28, 37, 46]) with absorbVoidRiftCB on each hit — not separately rendered.

Damage: skillAttack[N] multipliers apply skillAttack_1..5 with a4MultAttack scaling (1.0/1.1/1.2/1.7 based on getA4Stacks). A4 stack count gates on team Cryo/Hydro hits — see passive Return to Oblivion.

[A7] All Shall Wither has no matching primitive: no per-normal-hit proc-counted damage bonus with a 10-proc cap, compounded by Void-Rift-count scaling. The in-stance Cryo infusion (IgnoreInfusion blocks Pyro/Hydro/Electro override) is modeled correctly via the infusion:cryo variant, so it was dropped as working behavior.

abilities.name: Havoc: Warp
abilities.caveat: Shown as a brief instant; in game the Hold version is variable, player-controlled movement lasting up to ~3s, so its real timing depends on how long you hold.
_curatorNotes: Tap-E: skillFrames=InitAbilSlice(43), ActionAttack/Charge=21 ActionBurst=31 ActionDash=29 ActionJump=30 ActionSwap=29. enterSkillState fires after skillDelay=19f from cast.

Seven-Phase Flash state (skillKey): max duration skillDur=754f (12.57s) — bounded by Serpent's Subtlety pool depletion (gcsim drains 1.4 SS per 12f = 7/sec; starting +45 SS and the +10 SS C2 bonus → ~7.86s drain at C0). Modeled as duration:12.57 (max stance duration) — actual in-game duration depends on SS usage which the planner doesn't track. Stance ends early on swap (terminatesOnSwap:true), on E-burst (Havoc: Extinction does not exit), or on SS depletion.

Cooldown: SetCD(skill, 8*60) is called in exitSkillState (after stance ends), not on cast. Effective CD timing matches schema: cooldown 8s starts after duration ends (the existing parser accumulates duration → cooldown for stance abilities).

Tap-E grants 45 Serpent's Subtlety on entry; Hold-E grants 45 SS. SS modelled via two `gainStacks` effects (E3 v2.x): Tap-E carries the drain spec (7/sec while `inStance`), Hold-E omits it per first-spec convention. Burst consumes via the Q's `consumeStacks` effect; bonus DMG over 50 renders as a perStack-with-threshold buff bar gated on `stacks: { key: serpentsSubtlety, min: 51 }`. C2's +10 SS bonus is a third `gainStacks` on the constellation, gated on Cons:2 and firing on every E cast.

`max: 100` for the SS pool — no documented in-game cap; 100 is a generous safe upper bound that isn't reachable in practice (drain bounds in-stance accumulation; out-of-stance SS sits dormant until burst). The dynamic range that drives bonus DMG is 50–72 (cap +22 with C2), well below the pool ceiling.

Hold variant (Hold-E): skillHoldFrames=InitAbilSlice(18), ActionSwap=15. Cast also absorbs nearby Void Rifts during animation. Authored as variant with input: ['hE'], behavior: instant — does NOT open inStance.
Native gcsim NextQueueItemIsValid: skill cannot be re-cast while inStance (skillKey active). Planner can't enforce this; the in-stance E-recast slot is unused.

A6 rigor 2026-07-12: Hold-E gainStacks amount corrected 18 → 45 (gcsim skill.go skillHold calls AddSerpentsSubtlety 45.0 — the skillHoldGainSS=18 constant is a frame delay/CD offset, not the grant; kit text 'Hold: Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety' confirms). Caveat + note references updated 18→45.

[A7] Hold-E void-rift absorption is not simulated but is covered by the A1 passive gadget-gap caveat, so it was dropped here. Tap-opens-inStance vs Hold-as-instant-grant branching is modeled correctly. Variable hold duration = gcsim p['hold'] param, max ~3s, unrepresented.
abilities.description:
Imitates the combat style of "The Foul." Produces different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Skirk gains 45 **Serpent's Subtlety** and switches to **Seven-Phase Flash** mode.

Hold
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and will continuously move at high speed. Her interruption resistance is increased in this state.
During this time, Skirk can control her movement direction and move atop water. She can also use this Skill again to end rapid movement prematurely.

abilities.name: Havoc: Ruin
abilities.caveat: This burst spends Serpent's Subtlety, not Energy — it needs at least 50 and consumes everything accumulated. The timeline shows an Energy cost and doesn't enforce the 50 minimum, so it may fire when you'd lack enough in game.
_curatorNotes: Out-of-stance burst (Havoc: Ruin): 5 hits at burstHitmarks=[109, 111, 114, 125, 135] for burstDoT scaling, plus a Final hit at 158f for burstFinal scaling. Both gated on (burstDoT/burstFinal + bonusSS × burstBonus) × a4MultBurst (1.0/1.05/1.15/1.60 based on getA4Stacks).
Burst frames: burstFrames=InitAbilSlice(151), ActionAttack=100 ActionCharge=102 ActionSkill=102 ActionDash=102 ActionJump=102 ActionSwap=101. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J.
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(burst, 15*60, 0). EnergyMax=0; ConsumeSerpentsSubtlety(0) drains all SS on cast — modelled by the `consumeStacks` effect with `amount: 'all'`.

Bonus DMG from SS (modelled E3 v2.x): every SS over 50 (max +12 at C0, +22 at C2) → +1% burstDmgBonus per stack-over-threshold. Authored as a self buff with `value: { type: perStack, key: serpentsSubtlety, threshold: 50, maxStacks: 12, per: 1 }`, with constellationScaling raising maxStacks to 22 at C2. Buff `duration: 2.6` covers the burst's hit window (final hit at 158f from cast). Bar is gated on `stacks: { key: serpentsSubtlety, min: 51 }` so it only renders when the bonus is non-zero. consumeStacks fires AFTER the bar's stackContext snapshot is taken; the bar reflects pre-consume SS, the post-consume value carries forward at 0. a4MultBurst (Death's Crossing 1.0×–1.6×) is still NOT modelled (per-character-source on-team stack accumulator gap).

Variant Havoc: Extinction is authored as a separate burst entry below, gated on state:inStance. Extinction does NOT consume SS (no `consumeStacks` on its effects array) and does NOT carry the perStack bonus buff (the bonus is bound to Havoc: Ruin only).

[A7] The over-50 SS bonus DMG IS modeled (perStack buff, threshold 50, cap +12 / +22 at C2, snapshotting pre-consume SS via consumeStacks). energyCost=50 is a lint placeholder mirroring the SS threshold, not real Energy. The unmodeled part is purely the cast-time SS>=50 availability gate, which the planner does not enforce.
abilities.description:
Skirk's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Elemental Energy but instead on **Serpent's Subtlety**.
When Skirk has at least 50 Serpent's Subtlety, she can expend all her Serpent's Subtlety to unleash her Elemental Burst, ripping the space before her apart and using rapid consecutive slashes that deal AoE Cryo DMG. At the same time, the DMG dealt by an instance of this Elemental Burst will be increased by every point of Serpent's Subtlety over 50 when it is unleashed. Up to 12 points can be counted for this purpose.

abilities.name: Havoc: Extinction
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the 'All Shall Wither' bonus this grants — after it, normal hits deal extra DMG on a repeating 0.1s trigger (up to 10 times), scaled higher by Void Rifts absorbed during the cast.
_curatorNotes: In-stance burst variant (gated on state:inStance). Triggers only when in Seven-Phase Flash. Does NOT consume Serpent's Subtlety; does NOT exit the stance — Seven-Phase Flash continues until SS depletes, swap, or stance duration ends.
Burst frames: burstSkillFrames=InitAbilSlice(41), ActionAttack/Charge=39 ActionDash=40 ActionJump=40 ActionSwap=39. Per Q-spec swap/N/D/J (E omitted — can't recast E in stance).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(burst, 15*60, 0). Same 15s as Havoc: Ruin.

All Shall Wither: 12.5s buff (burstExtinctKey), 10-proc cap, 0.1s ICD per proc (burstICDKey). Each qualifying N hit gains +burstDMG[voids][lvl] DmgP. Not authored — schema has no per-NA proc-counted dmgBonus primitive (similar to the lacking onHit-from-summon trigger).

Void Rifts absorbed during cast: c.absorbVoidRifts() returns count 0-3, used to index burstDMG[voids][lvl] for All Shall Wither bonus. Void Rifts are A1-spawned by team Frozen/Superconduct/Cryo-Swirl/Cryo-Crystallize reactions — not modeled.

[A7] All Shall Wither has no matching primitive: per-normal-hit proc-counted bonus with a 10-proc cap plus Void-Rift-count scaling (0-3 rifts -> +0/+1/+2/+3, gcsim burstDMG[voids][lvl]). Correctly modeled and dropped: this variant consumes no SS and does not exit the stance.
abilities.description:
A special Elemental Burst that can be used even without consuming Serpent's Subtlety.
After using it, Skirk will gain the "All Shall Wither" effect, which will last until Seven-Phase Flash ends. After unlocking the Ascension Talent **Reason Beyond Reason**, she can also absorb nearby Void Rifts.
While "All Shall Wither" is active, every 0.1s, after Skirk's Normal Attack hits an opponent, that Normal Attack will deal increased DMG. If she absorbed any Void Rifts while using Havoc: Extinction, this Normal Attack's DMG will be further increased based on the number of Rifts absorbed.

passives.name: Reason Beyond Reason
passives.caveat: Not modeled: Void Rifts — reaction-spawned pickups absorbed for Serpent's Subtlety. In a standard Freeze team the SS pool stays full from other sources, so their absence does not change rotation choices.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-17, gadget category): Void Rifts share the same gadget-collectible primitive gap as Neuvillette's Sourcewater Droplets. Per the curation philosophy, the cost of building gadget state + per-rift onAbsorb triggers is high while canonical-Freeze auto-fulfills the SS pool — visualizing rifts wouldn't change rotation decisions. The stub IS the final state; caveat surfaces in the ability caveats panel.

[A7] Void Rifts: gadget collectibles spawned by team Frozen/Superconduct/Cryo-Swirl/Cryo-Crystallize (2.5s ICD, max 3 on field, ~17.6s lifetime), absorbed by in-stance CA, Hold-E, or Havoc: Extinction for +8 SS each. Same gadget-primitive gap as Neuvillette droplets; canonical Freeze (Escoffier + Hydro) auto-fills the SS pool.
passives.description:
When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Cryo Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions against opponents, a Void Rift will be created near this opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s. 3 Void Rifts created by Skirk herself can exist on the field at once.

Skirk can use the following methods to absorb nearby Void Rifts:
· When she hits an opponent with a Charged Attack in her **Seven-Phase Flash** mode.
· When she uses the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in Seven-Phase Flash mode.
· When she Holds her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp to engage in rapid movement.

Each Rift absorbed will grant her 8 **Serpent's Subtlety** points.

passives.name: Return to Oblivion

_curatorNotes: [cA-fold 2026-07-20] canonicalAssumption removed (type retired); its assumption text folded into the ability-level caveat. headlineValue equaled value (70).
[cA-fold 2026-07-20] canonicalAssumption removed (type retired); its assumption text folded into the ability-level caveat. headlineValue equaled value (60).

A4 (Death's Crossing): 2026-05-14 migrated from v0.8 per-cast sourceLifetime dispatch → teamElementCount Condition gating. Canonical Skirk comps always have 2-3 non-Skirk Cryo/Hydro members (Escoffier/Citlali/Wriothesley + Furina/Yelan/Sigewinne flex), so tier-N gating maps directly to non-Skirk-eligible-teammate count via the new `teamElementCount` Condition variant. Removed the 2 gainStacks effects (Cryo source='others', Hydro source='team' with sourceLifetime:20) since teamElementCount resolves canonically at planner time. The 6 tier buffs (3 NA + 3 burst) re-gate from `stacks: deathsCrossing` → `teamElementCount: elements:[cryo,hydro] comparison:= value:N` (tier-3 uses `>=3` since only one tier fires above the cap regardless). Tier-3 NA + burst gain `canonicalAssumption` markers for the canonical-team framing.

Tier multipliers (additive +10/+20/+70 normalDmgBonus and +5/+15/+60 burstDmgBonus) are mathematically equivalent to ×1.1/×1.2/×1.7 NA and ×1.05/×1.15/×1.6 burst in the standard Genshin damage formula `talent × (1 + ΣDmgBonus%)`.

Per-cast HitEvent emission from v0.8 is no longer consumed for Death's Crossing accrual but is retained on ParsedRotation for future renderer subscribers (Skirk-specific tests update accordingly). Per-hit fidelity (Cryo-infused teammate NAs) was already deferred under v0.8; the canonical-team-comp gating doesn't depend on per-hit granularity so the gap is no longer relevant for tier resolution.

[A7] Tier-3 headline +70% normalDmgBonus assumes 3 non-Skirk Cryo/Hydro teammates (e.g. Escoffier + Furina + Citlali). Tiers gate on teamElementCount and correspond to in-stance NA x1.1/x1.2/x1.7 of base.
[A7] Tier-3 headline +60% burstDmgBonus assumes 3 non-Skirk Cryo/Hydro teammates; tiers gate on teamElementCount, corresponding to in-game burst x1.05/x1.15/x1.6 of base.
passives.description:
When nearby Hydro party members' Hydro attacks hit opponents, or when nearby Cryo party members apart from Skirk hit opponents with Cryo attacks, Skirk will gain the "Death's Crossing" effect for 20s. Max 3 stacks, each stack's duration is counted independently.
Each character can grant Skirk at most 1 "Death's Crossing" stack by this means.
Each "Death's Crossing" stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by Skirk in **Seven-Phase Flash** mode to 110%/120%/170% of its original DMG and the DMG dealt when using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin to 105%/115%/160% of its original DMG.
passives.caveat: Assumes a full canonical team with 3 Cryo or Hydro teammates. With fewer eligible teammates, the lower Normal Attack (+10% / +20%) and Burst DMG (+5% / +15%) tiers fire instead.

constellations.name: Far to Fall
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the crystal blade added on each Void Rift absorbed, since Void Rifts are not simulated. In a standard Freeze team it is a predictable damage rider that does not shift rotation choices.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-17, gadget category): downstream of A1's Void Rift gap. Per the curation philosophy, the cost of building the gadget primitive + per-rift onAbsorb trigger is high while the bonus is canonical-rotation-invisible. The stub IS the final state.
[A7] C1 crystal blade: 500% ATK Cryo per absorbed rift, counted as CA. Downstream of the A1 Void Rift gadget gap (damage numbers are out of scope anyway).
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent **Reason Beyond Reason**: Every Void Rift absorbed will summon a crystal blade to attack nearby opponents, dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason.

constellations.name: Into the Abyss
_curatorNotes: C2 has three effects: (1) +10 SS on E cast (any tap or hold) — modelled E3 v2.x as a `gainStacks` effect on this constellation, gated on Cons:2, no input filter (fires on Tap-E and Hold-E alike); (2) +10 to the SS-bonus cap for Havoc: Ruin (raises max bonus from +12 SS counted to +22) — modelled via the burst's perStack `constellationScaling` (maxStacks 12→22 at C2); (3) +70% ATK for 12.5s after Havoc: Extinction (ends if Seven-Phase Flash ends earlier).

Effect (3) authored as self buff with onCast burst trigger, duration 12.5, conditions: all of [constellation:2, state:inStance]. The state:inStance condition restricts the buff to Havoc: Extinction casts (not Havoc: Ruin) — the parser stamps inStance per cast, so this resolves correctly.

Note: the effect is gcsim-modelled to also auto-end when skillKey ends (Seven-Phase Flash exit). Schema has no 'ends-when-state-ends' modifier; the 12.5s window is rendered fully even after stance exit. Acceptable trade-off.
constellations.description:
After unleashing her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp, Skirk will gain 10 additional **Serpent's Subtlety** points.
When using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, the DMG of this Elemental Burst instance will be increased by taking up to 10 more Serpent's Subtlety points into account.
Additionally, within 12.5s after Skirk unleashes the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in her **Seven-Phase Flash** mode, her ATK is increased by 70%. This effect will be canceled when she leaves the Seven-Phase Flash mode.

constellations.name: To the Source
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: this relies on Void Rifts, which are not simulated — the stacks, their coordinated attacks, and the in-stance damage reduction are absent. In a standard Freeze team it does not affect rotation choices.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-17, gadget category): downstream of A1's Void Rift gap. Three consumer-side primitive gaps stack on top (perStack damage scaling, onHit-from-N3/N5 trigger, on-character-hurt trigger) — even if the gadget primitive landed, the consumers would each need their own primitive build. Cost/value firmly favors stub. The stub IS the final state.

[A7] C6 Havoc: Sever consumers: Q consumes all stacks (750% ATK/stack Cryo); in-stance N3/N5 hit consumes a stack for 3x 180% ATK coordinated attacks; taking DMG in stance consumes a stack for 80% DR + 3x 180% ATK. All downstream of the A1 Void Rift gadget gap; damage numbers are out of scope regardless.
constellations.description:
Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent **Reason Beyond Reason** will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in **Seven-Phase Flash** mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."

Havoc: Sever
· When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, she will consume all Havoc: Sever stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each Havoc: Sever stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
· When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.
· When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
